rule.note: A feature is PROMOTED only when it clears the significance bar with the same sign in at least 3 different strategy families, and its direction repeats in the last-12-months lockbox of every one of those families.

features.name: mom_5
features.label: 5-bar momentum (in ATR units)
features.desc: How far price has moved over the last 5 bars, scaled by recent volatility.

features.name: mom_20
features.label: 20-bar momentum (in ATR units)
features.desc: How far price has moved over the last 20 bars, scaled by recent volatility.

features.name: atr_norm
features.label: Volatility level (ATR / price)
features.desc: Recent average bar range as a fraction of price — how choppy the tape is right now.

features.name: atr_ratio
features.label: Volatility expansion (fast ATR / slow ATR)
features.desc: Whether short-term volatility is running hot or cold compared to its own slow baseline.

features.name: trend_20
features.label: 20-bar trend strength
features.desc: How straight-line the last 20 bars have been (near 1 or -1 = trending, near 0 = choppy).

features.name: range_pos
features.label: Position in the 20-bar range
features.desc: Where the current price sits inside its own recent 20-bar high-low range, 0=low to 1=high.

features.name: dist_pdh_atr
features.label: Distance from yesterday's high (ATR units)
features.desc: How far the current price sits above or below the PRIOR session's high.

features.name: dist_pdl_atr
features.label: Distance from yesterday's low (ATR units)
features.desc: How far the current price sits above or below the PRIOR session's low.

features.name: dist_pdc_atr
features.label: Distance from yesterday's close (ATR units)
features.desc: How far the current price sits above or below the PRIOR session's closing price.

features.name: tod_sin
features.label: Time of day (clock, sine component)
features.desc: Where in the trading day this bar falls, encoded as a smooth clock position.

features.name: tod_cos
features.label: Time of day (clock, cosine component)
features.desc: Where in the trading day this bar falls, the other half of the clock encoding.

features.name: dow
features.label: Day of week
features.desc: Which weekday the trade entered on (Monday=0 .. Friday=4).

features.name: rsi14
features.label: Daily RSI(14), prior day
features.desc: Yesterday's 14-day Relative Strength Index — how overbought or oversold the daily chart was.

features.name: macd_hist
features.label: Daily MACD histogram, prior day
features.desc: Yesterday's MACD momentum histogram, normalized by price.

features.name: atr20_pctile
features.label: Daily volatility percentile, prior day
features.desc: Where yesterday's 20-day average daily range ranked against the last year — a calm-vs-wild reading.

features.name: er20
features.label: Daily efficiency ratio (20d), prior day
features.desc: Yesterday's ratio of net move to total path length over 20 days — high means trending, low means choppy.

features.name: gap_pct
features.label: Today's open gap vs yesterday's close
features.desc: How far today's opening price jumped from yesterday's close, in percent.

features.name: prev_ret
features.label: Prior day's return
features.desc: Yesterday's close-to-close percent change.

features.name: range_pctile
features.label: Daily range percentile, prior day
features.desc: Where yesterday's high-low range ranked against the last year.

features.name: up_streak
features.label: Consecutive up/down day count, prior day
features.desc: How many days in a row closed up (positive) or down (negative) through yesterday.

features.name: vix
features.label: VIX level, prior close
features.desc: Yesterday's closing VIX (stock-market fear gauge) level.

features.name: vix_pctile_1y
features.label: VIX percentile (1yr), prior close
features.desc: Where yesterday's VIX ranked against the last year — high means unusually fearful markets.

features.name: vix_chg_5d
features.label: VIX 5-day change, prior close
features.desc: How much the VIX moved over the prior 5 trading days.

features.name: vix_term
features.label: VIX term structure (3mo - spot)
features.desc: Whether longer-dated VIX futures expect calm or more fear than right now (negative = stress).

features.name: tnx
features.label: 10-year Treasury yield, prior close
features.desc: Yesterday's 10-year Treasury yield level.

features.name: tnx_chg_20d
features.label: 10-year yield 20-day change
features.desc: How much the 10-year Treasury yield moved over the prior month.

features.name: curve
features.label: Yield curve (10y minus 3mo)
features.desc: The gap between long and short interest rates — negative means the curve is inverted.

features.name: dist_sma20d_atr
features.label: Distance from the 20-day average price (ATR units)
features.desc: How far yesterday's close sits above or below its own 20-day average, scaled by volatility.

features.name: dist_sma50d_atr
features.label: Distance from the 50-day average price (ATR units)
features.desc: How far yesterday's close sits above or below its own 50-day average, scaled by volatility.

features.name: dist_sma200d_atr
features.label: Distance from the 200-day average price (ATR units)
features.desc: How far yesterday's close sits above or below its own 200-day average, scaled by volatility.

features.name: pos_prev_week
features.label: Position inside the week-before-last's range
features.desc: Where yesterday's close sat inside the high-low range of the week before last, 0=low to 1=high.

features.name: prev_day_close_pos
features.label: Yesterday's close position in its own range
features.desc: Where yesterday closed inside its own high-low range for that day, 0=low to 1=high.

features.name: compressed_60m
features.label: Hourly chart is coiled (squeeze on)
features.desc: Whether the 60-minute chart was in a volatility squeeze (coiled, about to move) just before entry.
